project-title.title: Leveraging Domain Knowledge for Improving Neural Network's Explainability and Robustness
Leveraging Domain Knowledge for Improving Neural Network's Explainability and Robustness

project-description.description:
Although inspired by the human brain, current artificial neural networks are still very distant from their biological counterparts. Two differences stand out. First, humans can symbolically explain their reasoning using concepts, relationships, implications and causation as building blocks, whereas neural network models are inherently opaque, making it difficult to understand whether their outputs come from what we would consider sound reasoning, or just from spurious correlations. Second, humans can guide their learning processes using symbolic domain knowledge, namely, to prevent learning certain concepts, relations, implications, or causations, for example to obey some legal, or even moral requirements, whereas neural networks only learn what is present in the data.
This project aims at developing methods and tools to bridge the gap between symbolic and neural AI, specifically to a) generate symbolic explanations for neural networks and b) incorporate existing domain knowledge and constraints into the neural network learning process.

items.abstract: The advent of Artificial Intelligence (AI) has revolutionized web crawling techniques, enhancing the process of knowledge graph building by enabling more efficient data extraction, classification, and semantic understanding. This paper explores how AI technologies, particularly Natural Language Processing (NLP) and machine learning, can be leveraged to improve web crawling for the creation of advanced knowledge graphs. Traditional web crawling methods often struggle with the complexity and scalability required for large-scale knowledge graph construction, but AI-driven techniques can significantly enhance data quality, reduce noise, and identify semantic relationships across diverse data sources. By incorporating AI-driven algorithms, such as entity recognition, sentiment analysis, and topic modeling, the automated extraction of valuable information from unstructured web data becomes more accurate and context-aware. This paper also discusses various AI-enhanced web crawling frameworks and tools, highlighting their ability to dynamically adapt to changing data environments and improve the overall efficiency and accuracy of knowledge graph construction. The findings suggest that integrating AI into web crawling not only accelerates the process but also leads to the creation of more accurate, scalable, and semantically rich knowledge graphs.
title: Leveraging AI in Web Crawling for Enhanced Knowledge Graph Building
